historical_references.reference: Ibn Hajar al-Haytami mentions a Sadit ibn al-A'war in his work 'al-Fatawa al-Hadithah'. He was a prominent scholar and the author of 'al-Madkhal ila al-Fuqaha' and 'al-Mawsu'ah al-Kabirah'. Sadit died during the Ottoman period, around 1566.

Al-Dhahabi records in his 'Tadhkirat al-Huffaz' a Sadit ibn al-Faqih al-Khurasani. He was a renowned hadith scholar and the author of 'Targhib al-Masabih'. Sadit was born in the 5th century AH (11th century AD) and died in the 6th century AH (12th century AD) in Khwarazm.
historical_references.time_period: 5th to 6th century AH (11th to 12th century AD)
